description: Option B (bean qou-dvlt): the modular dual's ~1e-165 suppression at the substrate is INTRINSIC, not an arg-b artifact. With b^2 = i y the reciprocity log q * log q~ = 4 pi^2 holds identically in y — the y cancels — so demanding a real q leaves no convention to re-choose. Measured at the substrate: Re(b^2) = 0 exactly, q = 1/q0 exactly, reciprocity to 0.0 relative error. The double balances at |log q| = 2pi (q = e^-2pi ~ 0.00187); the substrate's |log q| = 0.10434 is 60.2x too close to 1, forcing |log q~| = 378.3 and |q~| ~ 4.8e-165. For the dual merely to clear double precision one would need q0 > 2.92. This closes front (a) as stated: PR #5093 proved the parity read-off needs a PAIR, and the pair's second entry is numerically absent at the substrate — with q0 an input, nothing can be re-chosen. Scope-(b); says nothing about (H1).
